resources.string: Takes screenshots of the game\'s screen and taps and swipes in it, only while an auto expedition run is going (debug builds also tap for auto nectar). It never reads window content, and screenshots are never saved or sent. Any app can see which accessibility services are on, so turn this off when you do not need it.

It can send fruit and seedling expeditions for you, and feed nectar.\nIt needs the accessibility service \"Pikmin Bloom GPS: Auto actions\" (Android 11 or newer), which reads the screen and taps only while a run goes.\nAny app can see enabled accessibility services, so turn it off when you do not need it.
Auto actions needs Android 11 or newer. This phone runs Android %1$s (API %2$d). Check Settings → About phone → Android version. It is not the MIUI or EMUI version.
